feed.title: RIVER Lab
feed.subtitle: Research lab at CSRE, IIT Bombay working on satellite remote sensing, hydrological modelling, and water-resource management for regulated rivers and reservoirs.

entry.title: Shanta Panja joins RIVER Lab as a PhD student

link.title: Shanta Panja joins RIVER Lab as a PhD student

entry.content: We welcome Shanta Panja to the RIVER Lab! Shanta joins us as a PhD student and will be investigating the estimation of groundwater seepage from reservoirs using satellite observables.
entry.summary: We welcome Shanta Panja to the RIVER Lab! Shanta joins us as a PhD student and will be investigating the estimation of groundwater seepage from reservoirs using satellite observables.

entry.title: Pritam Das joins CSRE, IIT Bombay as Assistant Professor

link.title: Pritam Das joins CSRE, IIT Bombay as Assistant Professor

entry.content: We are officially launching RIVER Lab at the Centre of Studies in Resources Engineering (CSRE), IIT Bombay. The lab will focus on satellite remote sensing of water bodies, regulated river hydrology, and open-source hydrological software. Positions for PhD students and research associates are open – see the Join page for details.

entry.title: New paper on SWOT reservoir monitoring published in Earth and Space Science

link.title: New paper on SWOT reservoir monitoring published in Earth and Space Science

entry.content:
Our paper on multi-satellite tracking of surface water storage in the SWOT era is now published in Earth and Space Science. We show that SWOT achieves near-order-of-magnitude improvement in elevation RMSE over pre-SWOT approaches for reservoir storage estimation.

Read the paper

entry.title: Paper on forecast-informed reservoir operations published in Journal of Hydrologic Engineering

link.title: Paper on forecast-informed reservoir operations published in Journal of Hydrologic Engineering

entry.content:
Our paper exploring forecast-informed dam operations in ungauged mountainous basins using GEFS and the RAT satellite framework is now published in Journal of Hydrologic Engineering (ASCE). We apply the framework to the 2018 Kerala floods as a globally representative test case.

Read the paper

entry.title: RAT published as a Python package in Digital Water

link.title: RAT published as a Python package in Digital Water

entry.content:
The Reservoir Assessment Tool (RAT) is now available as a conda-installable Python package with a command-line interface, CI/CD pipeline, and full documentation at ratdocs.io. The paper describing the package is published in Digital Water.

Read the paper
